afterImage.description: Mercury Fiber is a facilities-based rural broadband platform that develops and operates fiber-to-the-premises and fixed-wireless networks across underserved communities in the central United States. Formerly known as Mercury Broadband and Mercury Wireless, the company provides residential and business internet service through owned last-mile and supporting network infrastructure. Northleaf completed a controlling investment on October 31, 2022 through NCP Mercury AIV LP and Mercury TopCo, LLC. Mercury's pre-closing owner retained minority rollover equity, but the parties' current exact economic percentages and Northleaf fund allocation are not publicly disclosed.
